traffic_settings_policy: Exact approved VSL/meter events only; zero demand/route/urban/seed/SimRes writes

fixed_profile_proof.event_clock: No control writes; native resolution is a diagnostic scenario variable, not equivalent traffic
fixed_profile_proof.scope: Fixed-command causal diagnostic; no controller optimization, N_UF feasibility or GNE certification

rule_policy.parameter_status: Exploratory ALINEA target15pct and gain70veh/h/pct/lane; not calibrated critical occupancy or a validated physical capacity.
